note: Bitterroot NF (Darby RD) campground along Skalkaho Creek, 12.9 mi east of US-93 on the Skalkaho Hwy (MT-38), ~16 mi S of Hamilton; small and quiet though near the highway. Skalkaho Falls is 8.5 mi east, where the highway becomes narrow dirt (gated in winter). Food-storage order in effect March 1 - December 1. --Claude
summary: Forest Service (Bitterroot NF, Darby RD), free, first-come. Confirmed $0, no hookups, 6 sites to 50 ft, vault toilet, no potable water, FCFS (page updated 2026-10-06). Added open yearlong until closed by snow, 16-day limit. No alert names it. Note trimmed of restated values.
